problem: What is the radius of the sphere ${x}^{2}+4x+{y}^{2}+(z-3)^{2}=12?$

feedback.problem: What are the radius $r$ and the coordinates of the center $C$ for the sphere ${x}^{2}+(y+3)^{2}+(z-1)^{2}=2?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the equation of a sphere centered at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ with radius $r>0$ is given by

$$
(x-{x}_{0})^{2}+(y-{y}_{0})^{2}+(z-{z}_{0})^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

We can write our equation as

$$
{x}^{2}+(y-(-3))^{2}+(z-1)^{2}=(\sqrt{2})^{2},
$$

which gives us the center at the point point $C(0,-3,1)$ and the radius $r=\sqrt{2}.$
